people.name: Pilate
people.line: Roman governor who presided over Jesus' trial

translations.web: Then Pilate went out again, and said to them, “Behold, I bring him out to you, that you may know that I find no basis for a charge against him.”
translations.bsb: Once again Pilate came out and said to the Jews, “Look, I am bringing Him out to you to let you know that I find no basis for a charge against Him.”
translations.kjv: Pilate therefore went forth again, and saith unto them, Behold, I bring him forth to you, that ye may know that I find no fault in him.
translations.asv: And Pilate went out again, and saith unto them, Behold, I bring him out to you, that ye may know that I find no crime in him.
